features: Operating System, PrimeOS: Experience the best of both worlds with PrimeOS. Enjoy Android's familiarity and vast app ecosystem, combined with a desktop interface for multitasking, productivity, and entertainment. Even explore coding tools!
MediaTek Power: The Mediatek MT8183 processor at 2 GHz ensures smooth multitasking, fast app launches, and efficient performance for work and play.
5GHz Wifi Connectivity: Stay ahead of the curve with super-fast Wifi connectivity. Experience productivity with zero latency.
Ample Storage & Memory: 4GB of RAM keeps things running smoothly, while the 64 GB storage provides plenty of space for apps, files, and media.
Vivid 11.6" HD Display: The 11.6-inch HD IPS display delivers crisp visuals and vibrant colors for an immersive viewing experience.
Essential Ports: Type-C (1x) Charging, USB (x2), Mini HDMI (1x), 3.5 mm Audio Jack (1x), Micro SD Slot (1x)
Sleek & Portable Design: The Primebook 4G is thin, lightweight, and travel-friendly, making it perfect for taking your digital world with you.
description: Primebook WiFi presents an ideal solution for the needs of the next generation of students. With a high-performance Mediatek processor and a round-the-clock battery life, Primebook laptops ensure extended hours of uninterrupted learning. Based on PrimeOS, an Android 11-based operating system this range of laptops offers a seamless and Immersive Interface. Elevating the learning experience of users with 50,000+ fun and engaging Android apps.
